Pumpkin Smoothie
By: Alison Cunha
Published: Monday, December 21, 2009 - 12:00pm

Ingredients




6 ounces of fat free vanilla yogurt (I used Stoneyfield)
3/4 cup of a  of canned pumpkin
 cup of a  of OJ
1 banana (can be frozen or fresh)
ice cubes

1 tablespoon of brown sugar
a few sprinkles of cinnamon

dash of cloves

Preparation

1 Put all ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth.

About


Morning!!! Hope you are having a super Thursday morning! Let’s jump right in shall we?!
Here is breakfast:
Wait a second, that’s not green!! This is the first time you guys have seen a smoothie on here that isn’t green, right? In fact, this one is orange! I wonder what is in it that makes it orange? Do you guys have any guesses?
If you guessed PUMPKIN, you are correct!!! I started off my morning with a yummy, creamy pumpkin smoothie!!!! Want to know how to make it too?
You will need:
   1. 6 oz of fat free vanilla yogurt (I used Stoneyfield)
   2. 3/4 of a cup of canned pumpkin
   3. 1/3 of a cup of OJ
   4. 1 frozen banana
   5. 4 ice cubes
   6. 1 TBS of brown sugar
   7. 1/2 a teaspoon of cinnamon
   8. a dash of cloves
Put all the ingredients in a blender and blend. It was so good!!! I opened a huge can of pumpkin yesterday, so I have been trying to find uses for it, this was super good!!!!
I also had coffee (obvi).
Here is today’s outfit…it is going to be 70 degrees here today!!!
Black Skirt (Target), White floral Blouse (Kohl’s), Black Pumps (Marshall’s).
Today is probably the last day for a while when it will be warm enough to wear a shirt like this, so I took advantage of that!I love the way this blouse fits!! I actually bought it to wear to my Nana’s funeral in March of 2007, I was giving the eulogy and had to look nice. When I saw it in the store, it reminded me of her so much, I bought it to wear that day. Every time I wear it, I think of her, but not in a sad way!
Have a Terrific Thursday!!!!! See you guys later!
